entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: A powerful demon of Innistrad, bound in the bone sword Elbrus, infamous for slaying Saint Traft.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A monster slayer led into a trap by the Skirsdag and slain by Withengar.

entities.name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade
entities.description: A bone sword in which Withengar's essence was bound.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose absence caused the events of Dark Ascension.

entities.name: Dark Ascension
entities.description: Events during which Withengar was reincarnated.
